option.value: RacketMatchApp – Project Rules - Language: Kotlin only. - UI: Prefer Jetpack Compose + Material 3. If XML is required, keep layouts minimal and consistent. - App goal/UX: Optimize for fast scoring during a match: very large text, huge +/− buttons, minimal clicks, clear match state (sport, teams, points, sets), quick “end match” flow, and optional vibration feedback. - Architecture: Use MVVM (ViewModel + immutable UI state). Match rules go in a pure Kotlin MatchLogic/domain layer (unit-testable). - Persistence: Use Room for saved matches + history. Use DataStore (Preferences) for “reuse last settings automatically”. - Output format (when you answer): Brief plan, 2) exact files to create/edit, 3) Kotlin code, 4) how to test it, 5) common pitfalls.
